en: The Mañjuśrī-bodhisattva-praṇidhāna Sūtra,
translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Buddhabhadra of India during the Eastern Jin Dynasty:
Purifying body, speech, and mind, one eliminates all defilements and impurities.
With single-minded reverence, I pay homage to the Buddhas of the ten directions and the three periods of time.
By the power of Samantabhadra’s vows, I behold all the Buddhas;
before each and every Tathāgata, I prostrate as many times as there are atoms in all lands.
Within a single mote of dust, one sees all Buddhas surrounded by hosts of bodhisattvas;
so it is with every atom throughout the dharma-realm.
With myriad wondrous voices, they proclaim the praises of the Most Victorious Ones.
The ocean of immeasurable merit cannot be exhausted;
by the power of Samantabhadra’s conduct, with supreme and manifold offerings,
I make offerings to all Buddhas of the ten directions and the three periods of time.
With exquisite fragrant flower garlands, Various kinds of music and dance,
And all manner of sublime adornments, I universally make offerings to all Buddhas.
Through greed, hatred, and delusion, I have committed every kind of evil deed.
All unwholesome deeds of body, speech, and mind, I repent and completely eliminate.
All the merit of all sentient beings, and the virtues of all śrāvakas,
pratyekabuddhas, bodhisattvas, and buddhas, I rejoice in them all.
To all Buddhas of the ten directions, when they have first attained equal and perfect enlightenment,
I exhort them all to turn the unsurpassed wheel of Dharma.
To those who manifest parinirvāṇa, I join my palms in reverence and entreat them.
Abiding through all atoms of kalpas, I bring peace and happiness to all living beings.
Whatever merit I have accumulated, I dedicate and bestow upon sentient beings,
so that they may perfect the bodhisattva practices and attain unsurpassed enlightenment.
I offer worship to all Buddhas of the past and the present throughout the ten directions;
may the World-Honored Ones of future ages swiftly attain the path of Bodhi.
May they universally adorn all Buddha-lands throughout the ten directions.
The Tathāgata sits at the site of enlightenment, surrounded by a multitude of Bodhisattvas.
May all sentient beings of the ten directions eliminate all afflictions,
deeply comprehend the true meaning, and always abide in peace and happiness.
I have cultivated the bodhisattva practices and attained the wisdom of recollecting past lives;
having eliminated all obstacles, they are forever exhausted without remainder.
I am completely free from birth and death, as well as all demons, afflictions, and karmic actions.
Like the sun abiding in the void, And the lotus flower unstained by water,
He travels everywhere throughout the ten directions, Teaching and transforming all living beings.
He eliminates the sufferings of the evil realms And brings the bodhisattva practices to fulfillment.
Though conforming to the ways of the world, I shall not forsake the Bodhisattva path;
throughout all kalpas until the end of the future, I will fully cultivate the practices of Samantabhadra.
If there are those who practice together with me, may we always gather in one place.
May all virtuous deeds of body, speech, and mind be made entirely equal.
If one encounters a spiritual friend who reveals the conduct of Samantabhadra,
may one draw near to such a bodhisattva and never be parted from them.
Constantly seeing all Buddhas surrounded by hosts of Bodhisattvas,
throughout all kalpas until the end of the future, I shall reverently make offerings to them all.
I shall protect the teachings of all Buddhas and praise the practices of Bodhisattvas.
Cultivating throughout all kalpas of the future, One ultimately perfects the path of Samantabhadra.
Though remaining within the cycle of birth and death, One possesses inexhaustible merit,
wisdom, skillful means, And all samādhis and liberations.
Within each and every atom, one sees inconceivable lands;
within each and every land, one sees inconceivable Buddhas.
Thus one sees all the oceans of worlds throughout the ten directions.
In each and every ocean of worlds, one beholds oceans of Buddhas.
Within a single utterance of speech, all wondrous sounds are contained;
within each and every wondrous sound, the most supreme sound is fully present.
By the power of profound wisdom, they enter inexhaustible sublime sounds and turn the pure,
true wheel of Dharma of all Buddhas of the three periods of time.
All future kalpas can be made into a single thought-instant.
All kalpas of the three periods of time are entirely made into a single moment;
within that single moment, one sees all the Tathāgatas of the three periods,
and also universally discerns and knows their liberations and realms.
Within a single atom, the pure lands of the three periods of time emerge;
so too do all the atoms of the ten directions adorn the lands.
One sees therein all future Buddhas attaining enlightenment and turning the wheel of Dharma.
Having brought the Buddha-work to ultimate completion, he manifests entry into nirvana.
His supernatural powers travel everywhere; the power of the Mahāyāna is universal;
the power of compassion covers all; and the power of his practice brings merit to fulfillment.
The power of merit is pure; the power of wisdom is unimpeded.
Through the power of samādhi and skillful means, one attains the power of bodhi.
The power of pure wholesome karma eliminates and extinguishes the power of afflictions.
Destroying the powers of all Māras, Possessing the power of Samantabhadra’s conduct,
Adorning and purifying oceans of Buddha-fields, Liberating oceans of sentient beings,
Discerning oceans of various karmas, And exhausting the depths of the ocean of wisdom.
I have purified the ocean of all practices, fulfilled the ocean of all vows,
and beheld the ocean of all Buddhas throughout an ocean of kalpas.
I have practiced the deeds of the Buddhas of the three periods of time, as well as their immeasurable great vows.
I shall fully accomplish all these, attaining Buddhahood through the practices of Samantabhadra.
Bearing the name of the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, the foremost son of all Buddhas—
may I dedicate my roots of goodness so that I may become entirely equal to him.
With body, speech, and mind purified, They adorn buddha-fields with sovereign mastery;
Attaining equal and perfect enlightenment, They are all identical to Samantabhadra.
Just as Mañjuśrī and The practices of Bodhisattva Samantabhadra,
All my roots of goodness, I dedicate in this same way.
The path of dedication praised by all Tathāgatas of the three times—
I dedicate these roots of goodness to bring the conduct of Samantabhadra to full completion.
May at the time of my death, all obstacles be eliminated;
may I behold Amitābha face-to-face and be reborn in the Land of Peace and Bliss.
Having been born in that Buddha-land, may I fulfill all my great vows.
The Tathāgata Amitābha appeared before me and bestowed upon me this prophecy:
"Purify the practices of Samantabhadra, fulfill the vows of Mañjuśrī,
and throughout all kalpas until the end of the future, bring the bodhisattva path to ultimate completion."
The Sutra on Mañjuśrī’s Aspiration for Enlightenment
